title: Minigame: A10.6 Rally

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as a minigame of the Rules-first plan's proving slice (section 8): the fewest counters a rally needs, on an imported board.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): the units are set up by hand, a broken squad with a leader in a building or woods, in the RPh.

introduction: A broken squad tries to rally beside its leader.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
